articleTitle: Research on metrology for microwave landing system simulator
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The author presents the series of research achievement on metrology for microwave landing system (MLS) simulator, including demonstration for parameter system of metrology, methology for metrology support and development of automatic metrology system. The application shows that the findings have surmounted technical difficulties of MLS simulator metrology support and ensured the parameters accuracy and consistency of MLS, which make sense for improving flight safety.

articleTitle: Mechanical and electrical device condition trend prediction based on GA-SVR
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: This paper mainly discuss three kinds of optimization method to get the optimal penalty factor C and kernel parameter G of support vector regression. the mean square error MSE, correlation coefficient R, the number of support vector nsv was regarded as indexes to measure the merits of the various optimization prediction model, the experimental results shows that the prediction model based on genetic optimization is closer to the actual value in the prediction of vibration intensity, and prediction performance is better than other optimization methods. It also shows the prediction model has a good predictive ability on the condition trend of mechanical and electrical device.

articleTitle: Design of digital type inductance sensor
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The inductance sensor is often used for the measurement of displacement, pressure because of its simple structure, reliability and high precision. Usually the inductance sensor adopts AC electric bridge as its converting circuit to turn the sensor's inductance into an AC voltage signal. So it is difficult to make digital processing directly for the user. This paper introduces a converting circuit with digital interface. This circuit can turn the inductance signal produced by the inductance sensor into a RS232 serial digital signal. In addition, this circuit can provide exciting power independently and the extra exciting power is not needed, so it makes the application of the sensor simple. The inductance sensor equipped with this converting circuit can realize the digital output of the measured quantity. To the inductance sensor of different type, only little parameters of the circuit's software need to be modified, so this digital type inductance sensor has a higher practicality.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of complex impedance standard
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments

articleTitle: Design of multi-channel digital pulse signal generator
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: This paper describes a device that is multi-channel pulse signal generator based on digital. This device utilizes the computer serial port control mode and the digital technology of the electronic design automation (EDA). It is mainly implemented by the complex programmable logic device (CPLD). The experiment result shows that the pulse signal generator can generate the nine-channel pulse signal. The average relative deviation of each channel can reach to 40.7ps when the time interval is 100 microseconds. This generator can meet the requirement for the testing resolution of the multi-channels time interval measurement equipment.

articleTitle: Design and realization of multi-channel test Software based on Vector Network Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In order to verify the test results consistency, the design and realization of multi-channel test Software based on Vector Network Analyzer is introduced in this paper. The platform of software development is LabWindows/CVI. This software realizes multi-channel test by using switching network. It not only completes normal test of DUT (device under test), but also verifies the test results consistency, so the test results are more reliable. Meanwhile, it realizes that mass test data is quickly stored, compared and displayed through graphs. The database management system is MySQL database, which quickly processes data, and has large capacity. The Software is strong practicability and easy-to-use.

articleTitle: Design of modified sub-millimeter wave antenna measurement system
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces application of sub-millimeter wave antenna measurement system. Aimed at the low dynamic range in classic sub-millimeter wave antenna measurement systems, this paper presents several approach to improve system performance such as increasing local oscillator frequency, decreasing harmonic order of mixers and multi-level frequency conversion. The modified scheme is presented as well. Finally, we establish measurement system according to modified scheme and test its characteristics. The result shows that this scheme can improve dynamic range of sub-millimeter wave antenna measurement system efficiently so that it better satisfies the needs of sub-millimeter wave measurement.

articleTitle: Model establishment of microfluidic chip in form of planar coil for metal particles detection
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Base on electromagnetism and consideration of Eddy Current within the particles, the magnetization models of ferromagnetic metallic and non-ferromagnetic metallic particles are established in harmonic field. Combined with Electromagnetics model of the linear planar coil, relative inductance changes caused by particles pass is got in AC current. And the planar coil's sensitivity to particles after different relative permeability of particles, size of particles, parameters of planar coil and distance between particles and planar coil are discussed. The experiments test was carried out to various sizes of particles. The test indicated that Sensitivity can be improved by increase planar coil's intensity, decreasing the distance of detection.

articleTitle: The characteristic analysis and improvement based on group delay measurement of Frequency-Translating Devices by using double-frequency phase difference method
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Double-frequency phase difference method is a simple and effective means for measuring the group delay of Frequency-Translating Devices (FTD). Especially for measuring the group delay of FTD which cannot accept the other local oscillator, the method shows the irreplaceable advantage. In order to obtain an accurate description of the group delay characteristics in the pass band of FTD, two improved methods are put forward in this paper which are variable aperture measurement method and multiple-frequency phase difference(MFPD) method on the basis of the measuring group delay by using double-frequency phase difference(DFPD) method. The variable aperture measurement method uses genetic algorithm (GA) to optimize the measurement aperture and the measurement interval on the basis of the rate of the group delay, and the measured data is handled with the cubic spline interpolation and Taylor series expansion method. Finally, an accurate group delay characteristics curve of the system is fitted. The MFPD method turns the double-frequency into the multiple-frequency on the basis of the DFPD method, which improves the testing efficiency and the measurement accuracy in a great extent. However, the premise is that the measured output spectrum should have enough signal-to-noise ratio. The simulation results show that these two improved methods are equally effective in reducing the measurement error and improving the measurement accuracy greatly.

articleTitle: Design of multi-point home furnish security system based on star networking of sensors
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The designed system is a multi-point home security system, which uses the micro-controller AT89S52 as the core. The system mainly realizes the detection alarms of the multi-point home security based on the star networking of sensors, including position detection alarms and type detection alarms. The system also can display real-time time(Normal situation), alarm type and alarm time (when alarming)by LCD. The system would realize remote control and alarm by using RF wireless.

articleTitle: Research on error analysis and correction of LEMP magnetic field measurement device
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: According to the existing non-orthogonal error of lightning electromagnetic pulse (LEMP) magnetic field measurement device, the paper derives theoretical and actual output voltage of antennas induced by the alternating magnetic flux, which are generated by the current-carrying loop antenna injected with sine wave, gets the orthogonal extent and corrects the non-orthogonality of the device through simulation and calculation. In accordance with the existing low frequency distortion phenomenon of measured waveform, the paper uses output error (OE) system identification model to correct the error. The methods mentioned in this paper prove to be stable and efficient. It improves the accuracy of LEMP magnetic field measurement.

articleTitle: Dynamic performance analysis and identification of optics-camera testing-table
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Testing-equipment for calibrating spaced-optical cameras is in desperate need nowadays due to a growing of spaced-camera production. The accuracy gets more precise which put a great challenge on design and manufacturing of testing-equipment. In order to overcome the problem, a novel 4-axis testing-equipment has been designed, manufactured and tested. A dynamic model is established and calculated by FEA method. An experiment to identify dynamic parameters is done. The experimental results find great agreement with the dynamic simulation results data, which verifies the validity of the dynamic model we established.

articleTitle: Study of low-contrast digital meter image segmentation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: During the digital recognition process of digital display instrument, if there is no lighting or light is weak, the recognition rate comes low because of poor image quality. As to this problem, this paper proposes a new algorithm for image segmentation. The algorithm uses the histogram equalization to improve image contrast and enhance gray difference between the background and the area to be identified. And then it positions display area coarsely using the adaptive region growing method. Finally, the display area is precisely positioned by projection method. And adaptive threshold segmentation is done in this area. The experimental results show that the algorithm can rapidly and accurately position the display area of digital display instrument. And segmentation effect of the positioned image is improved obviously, effectively simplifying the subsequent digital recognition algorithms and guaranteeing its recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: MIMO radar signal design based on continuous chaos
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The orthogonality of the radar waveform is the key to achieve MIMO radar. The existing MIMO radar waveform design method is almost design complex, large amount of calculation, it is difficult to produce in large quantities. In order to solve this problem, this paper applies pseudo randomness, sensitivity to initial conditions, easy to produce and other characteristics of continuous chaotic signal(CCFMS), the proposed MIMO radar signal is based on continuous chaotic FM signal. First, CCFMS ambiguity function is deduced, then the distance and Doppler resolution performance of the signal is analyzed. On this basis, the cross correlation is analyzed, and the influence of the different continuous chaos system on the signal performance is compared. The theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the signal has approximately "thumbtack type" ambiguity function, excellent quasi-orthogonal and low interception capabilities, and the signal is easy to generate.

articleTitle: Experimental research on transient electromagnetic wave transmission characteristics in single-hole
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Borehole radar has a large detection range and relative high resolution, which makes up for the deficiency of the conventional logging tools and has been widely accepted as a highly efficient logging tool. The experimental research on the transmission characteristics of transient electromagnetic (EM) wave in a single borehole is of great significance to analyze the working characteristics of borehole radar system. After completing the time delay calibration, the transmission characteristics experiment in a single borehole filled with air at a limestone mine is carried out. The experimental results and theoretical analyses show that the direct wave travels along the sidewall, whose amplitude is very intense. The impedance mismatch can result in strong periodic reflection signals. These strong signals will bring about a serious disturbance to extract weak target echoes. Therefore, the impedance matching among the system modules when developing a borehole radar system should be regulated. Appropriate actions should be taken to highlight the weak echo signals during the data gathering and processing.

articleTitle: Investigation of EUT position of typical transient electromagnetic field facility
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The size and position of equipment under test are very important to keep inner TEM wave characteristics of transient electromagnetic facilities which count for much how to utilize them properly. This paper presents the research of EUT position of typical transient electromagnetic facility specified in MIL-STD-461F. Three transient electromagnetic structures are introduced and their inner field distributions are also analyzed respectively. Then a conclusion is summarized that in the recommended EUT position of these typical transient electromagnetic facilities, the electric field is in direct proportion to the voltage applied. This is quite beneficial not only to compute the inner electric field within the transient electromagnetic facilities, but also to evaluate the power needed to exert to them.

articleTitle: Single-sided sampling measurement for large solids of revolution and measurement uncertainty of cylindricity
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the precision of single-sided sampling measurement for large-scale solids of revolution was researched, in which only half of the surface was measured and laser trackers were expected to be used as measurement equipment. A cylinder was taken as example to be measured repeatedly in SA (Spatial Analyzer) software by its secondary development and simulation techniques. Monte Carlo method was used for evaluation of measurement uncertainties of cylindricity. Then some uncertainty results of different sampling strategies were compared and points number' influence on uncertainties were researched too.

articleTitle: Technique of non-linear surface form error on-line measurement
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Most of the current methods of accurate surface form error measurement is only suitable for linear and regular surface, there is no available accurate method for non-linear surface. This paper fund an online surface form error measurement system based on Time domain least-square serial two-point method which been upgrade by self-adaptable error separation matrix technique for uplift its ability to measure non-linear surface. The self-adaptable error separation matrix technique is allowed adjustment being placed automatically to the error separation matrix for non-linear surface error separation without compromise the accuracy of the system. The comparison of the result from the simulation which was being run on a non-linear surface of 10*9 grids clearly shows that the error's offset of the method in this paper is not larger than the random measurement error. Experimental results show that this method can work on the measurement of non-continuous, irregular surface without accuracy reduction.

Author Keywords: Time domain least-square serial two-point method
Measurement of non-linear surface form error

articleTitle: The measurement system of EMC antenna calibration based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Common methods and principles of antenna factor measurement are introduced. A comprehensive analysis is performed on electrical mast and background noise which could affect the antenna factor test. Then the corresponding solutions are given to deal with these problems. Considering the solutions and test process, an efficient program which integrated multiple functions like automatic cable loss calibration and automatic saving of data is developed based on LabVIEW, which makes it possible to completely build up an antenna test system. The system can prevent testers' misoperation, and the efficiency and accuracy of the measurement are greatly improved.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of certain type of tank fire control system based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In order to solve the problems existing in the fault diagnosis of tank fire control system, such as bigger subjectivity and less accuracy, a fault diagnosis model based on BP (Back Propagation) is studied. The working conditions of tank fire control system are described with a group of state parameters. A fault diagnosis model is established and a self adaptive variable BP learning algorithm is designed. Finally, a simulation is conducted with MATLAB. The results show that the convergence time of this algorithm is short, and this model is able to make fire control system fault diagnosis rapidly and accurately.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of analog circuits based on phasor circle model
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Algorithm of phasor circle model, a fault modeling on complex plane for fault dictionary in time domain analysis of linear analog circuit, is presents. The proposed algorithm achieved to characterize all potential fault status of each component with a circle on complex plane, using a voltage measurement approach on the only output node, and the unified mathematical formula of all complex circle is also presented with the parameters of center coordinate and radius. Furthermore, an approach of design for testability is discussed to minimize the ambiguous group. This algorithm can be used for identifying both soft fault and hard fault. Finally, an example circuit is presented to verify the efficient of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Active broadband low-frequency smart transducer with negative capacitance
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The effective stiffness and the natural frequencies of a piezoelectric system shunted with negative capacitance could be changed with the capacitance ratios. Integrated the shunted piezoelectric stacks with driven piezoelectric patches, a novel non-resonant smart transducer is put forward and its low frequency performance is enhanced obviously. The proposed smart transducer is simulated with multi-physics coupled finite element method. When negative capacitance is selected properly, the radiated sound pressure level of the smart transducer could be increased significantly in much wide band at low frequencies. The smart transducer can be used to generate high power, multi-frequencies sound signal simultaneously.

articleTitle: New estimation method of short circuit inductance of coplanar probe for on-wafer scattering parameter measurement
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The short impedance standard is the easiest fabricated in Open-Short-Load (OSL) calibration method for on-wafer scattering parameter (S-parameter) measurement. The fabrication and the definition of the other two impedance standard are more questionable. A new extraction method is presented to determine short inductance of coplanar waveguide (CPW) probe. Based on this consideration, other open capacitance and load inductance in OSL calibration method are compensated. The method needs only imperfective OSL impedance calibration kits and another standard offset short. It may improve on-wafer S-parameter accuracy of OSL calibration, which is the same as Thru-Reflect-Line (TRL) calibration. The experimental verification of the new estimation algorithm is given by using the designed and fabricated OSL calibration kit and standard offset short on Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> substrate up to 50 GHz.

articleTitle: Design of adjustable pulse module with FPGA-based 0.1ns resolution
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments

articleTitle: Design of frequency measurement system in external field
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The paper proposes the design of frequency measurement system in external field. The system is designed to meet the mobility and integration for complex external field test. The system uses a method of continuous sampling for the frequency difference multiplication. The measurement resolution is improved by using double-balanced mixer to achieve mixing module, filter circuit, and so on. According to the GPIB interface characteristics, D7210C, 75160BN and 75161BN chip are used to complete the task that is bi-directional, asynchronous, accurate and reliable data communications between computer equipment and measuring instruments. The software is designed to complete automatic measurement of atomic frequency in external field. The system meets the test requirements through the data obtained in laboratory and external field. The uncertainty of the system has reached 4E-13.

articleTitle: Aperture analysis of group delay measurement based on spread spectrum modulation
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Modulation method is a series of effective approach for group delay measurement, especially in applications of Frequency-Translating Devices (FTD). The spread spectrum modulation approach has the advantages of precision and robustness by using correlation operation to obtain the relative delay. In this paper, the aperture of this method is discussed based on the measurement principle and an improved measurement approach is proposed. The digital simulations prove the effectiveness of the improved approach.

articleTitle: EMD-based signal denoising in EMP measurement system
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: To remove the interference of strong environmental noise, fiber-optic transmission system is usually used in the measurement of electromagnetic pulse (EMP). However, due to the thermo-noise in fiber optic emitting and receiving circuits, there are still some inevitable noise in the transmission system. This effect limits the use of the EMP measurement system in shielded enclosures. An improved signal denoising method based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD) to enhance the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in EMP measurement has been proposed. The method we proposed is validated through simulation and real EMP experiments data, and it, compared to other approach, has better stability in the case of signals with lower initial SNR (-2 to 5 dB). The dynamic range of fiber-optic transmission system raised about 20 dB.

articleTitle: Combination of wavelet transform with EMD to distinguish overlapped Lamb wave packets
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In the non-destructive testing for plate structure with ultrasonic Lamb wave, it is hard to discriminate the overlapped scattered signal from different targets. To solve this problem, Lamb wave signal is decomposed into a set of elemental signals called “intrinsic mode functions” by empirical mode decomposition (EMD) method first, and the local maximum of the wavelet coefficients of the elemental signals is used to describe the dispersive curve of damage packets. This method can clearly find the differences of two overlapped wave packets based on time-frequency distribution map and the dispersion curve of Lamb-wave. The experiments show that this method is capable of separating the overlapped damage wave components, which is superior to the conventional Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT) and wavelet transform methods.

articleTitle: Research on the calibration technique of on-wafer load-pull system
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: By using load-pull technique, non-linear device behavior can be obtained through changing the source impedance or load impedance. Load-pull system is so complex that there is no effective way for its performance metrology, which results in significant variance of device parameter, such as power, gain, and PAE. This paper discusses in-situ calibration of on-wafer load-pull system and provides the verified result. The technique mentioned in this paper can calibrate the performance of the on-wafer load-pull system reliably and roundly, and give the measurement uncertainty of the system. Thus the calibration scheme is more reasonable, while the measurement result is more reliable.

articleTitle: Research on fast measurement method for active element pattern of phased array antenna
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: A novel fast measurement approach in the phase-shift measurement method to obtain the active element pattern in phased array antenna is investigated in this paper. The active element pattern is not only used in the process of solving each channel excitation, but also needed in the recovery of whole pattern. Since the accuracy of active element pattern will directly affects the precision of fast measurement results, it is more important to determine the active element pattern accurately compared with other measurement methods. In this paper, the elements in the phased array antenna are composed of half-wave dipoles, and a novel determination method of active element pattern which achieves accurate pattern calculations with less computer memory and computation time is introduced. The calculating formulas are presented, and the correctness along with the feasibility of this proposed method is verified and illustrated through experimental simulation.

articleTitle: Research into prevention of errors of airline transport pilots: A rough set approach
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Aiming at prevent the errors of airline transport pilots, make sure the Safety Management System (SMS) advocated by ICAO, a theoretical framework is proposed base on the basis analysis of theories of human factors and human error prevention. Firstly, analysis the basic elements of flight errors by means of the data mining theory and the construct new rules of decision making, then provide knowledge validation services to certified senior pilots, with this method, the risk and mitigation of airline can be assessment.

articleTitle: Optimum design of electrostatic sensor conditioning circuit based on Multisim
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The velocity measurement of gas/solid two-phase flow can be obtained by using the electrostatic sensor combined with cross-correlation measuring techniques. In order to realize the electrostatic velocity measurement the high demand of the conditioning circuit is required. In this paper, the charge conversion circuit and the dynamic filter circuit, as the key parts of the conditioning circuit, are analyzed. The parameters of the circuits are optimized and simulated in Multisim. The rationality and practicality of the parameters are verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: Environment factor assessment based on degradation data and reaction rate model
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: This paper presents a method to assess the environment factor, which is used to discount data at accelerated operating condition into data at normal condition. This method combines degradation data with reaction rate model, considers the interior relationship between environment stress and product's degradation rate, which not only cut down the amount of work, but also can predict environment factor at some other stress. An approach based on the ratio of performance degradation rate is proposed to validate the results, and the effectiveness of proposed method is demonstrated by the example of carbon-film resistors.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling of GMI sensor with double-core structure
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the mathematical model of the GMI sensor with double-core structure is deduced. By analyzing the structure and the mathematical model of single-core GMI sensor, the drawback caused by bias current drift or temperature drift is found. According to the double-peak feature of the amorphous, GMI sensor with the double-core structure is given and the mathematical model of this sensor is developed, which can effectively improve the bias current stability and the temperature stability. Finally, the results are confirmed by experiments.

articleTitle: Research progress of metrology of digital modulation error parameters
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Digital modulation error parameters, such as error vector magnitude EVM, is important in test and measurement of information system. This paper introduces the technology research progress in the metrology of digital modulation error parameters. First, we point out the basic problems existing in the field, which is about traceability and parameter range of calibration, and describe the relevant research, such as the thinking and technology of the `RF waveform metrology'. Then, we highlight the research progress of our team: 1). The metrology method and system for digital demodulation error parameter based on CW combination, which fits BPSK, QPSK, 8PSK, 16QAM, 64QAM modulation: this method can achieve traceability and error setting ability in a wide range, when standard EvmRms is 1.585%, the expanded uncertainty (k=2) is 0.009%. 2). The metrology method and system for digital demodulation error parameter based on analog AM or PM. 3). The metrology method and system for digital demodulation error parameter based on IQ gain imbalance and phase imbalance. 4). The metrology method and system for digital demodulation error parameter based on analog PM in the aspect of GMSK and FSK modulation. 5). The metrology method and system for digital demodulation error parameter based on Baseband waveform design. Based on these methods, our proposal are given as follows: first, establish public metrology standard for digital modulation error parameters; second, develop a new type of instrument "vector signal analyzer calibrator".

articleTitle: Research on forward problem of tuber electrical resistance tomography system
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Electrical resistance tomography (ERT) has the advantages of low cost, non-invasion, no radiation and visualization, and it is a hot research topic in the industrial process tomography (PT). The ERT technology applied to the agriculture is a new research field, which can be used in the crop growth status monitoring, new varieties nurturing and fine cultivation of plants. In the paper, the working model of ERT under the condition of soil environment is studied; the sensitive field model is established and simulated by using COMSOL software. The affects brought by different excitation/measurement with different soil conductivity are studied in detail. The research can provide the significant guidance for the further study of backward problem in tuber ERT system.

articleTitle: Computational method of dielectric sensor design for two-phase flow measurement
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The structure design is the major concern in dielectric sensor in two-phase flow analysis. To optimize the design, computational method is used in the electrostatic field analysis with finite-element method. In the finite-element analysis, two electrodes are loaded with different constant voltages. Nodal variable voltage is resolved by the ANSYS Mechanical APDL solver. The stored energy is derived from the electric field intensity. The sensor capacitance is computed from the stored energy. Various sensor structures are examined under different flow conditions. Three rules are found in the process of sensor structure analysis: First, the sensitivity of dielectric measurement has no relationship to internal structure of the dielectric sensor. Second, the sensitivity decreases with the increasing of gap thickness, but the decreasing rate is becoming slow finally. Third, the sensitivity increases with the increasing of gap length, and the increasing rate is constant usually. The optimization design of dielectric sensor is a moderate gap thickness and a maximum gap length with an arbitrary internal structure.

articleTitle: Key technology design of 6 GSPS high-speed digital storage oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: With the growth of the ADC sampling bandwidth and the DSP theory and techniques becoming more sophisticated, the time-domain test based on real-time sampling, such as digital storage oscilloscope, is emerging to the mainstream of electronic test development, and also gestating the important transformation on electronic instrumentation systems. However, the extreme dependence on sampling rate and the rapidly inflated amount of information processing already become the time-domain test's bottleneck, and it greatly restricts the broadband time-domain test equipment's development and application. This paper introduced design method of a broadband high speed digital storage oscilloscope, including design objectives, the overall scheme and work flow, and accessed the results of the experimental testing and analysis.

articleTitle: A ±60° Field-of-View, highly compact, 3×3 integrated photo-diode array sensor for dual-axis solar tracking
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments

articleTitle: Dual channel evaluation of magnetic shielding effectiveness by virtual instrumentation
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Magnetic shielding material is widely used in industrial and commercial society. How to evaluate the magnetic shielding effectiveness is a hot research topic. In this paper, we simultaneously monitor two channels (B, H) to find the shielding effectiveness and proper shielding condition for soft magnetic shielding material. This work is quite meaningful in design multilayer magnetic shielding.

articleTitle: Ground moving targets detection system based on time-frequency 2D detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: To solve the problem that false alarm rate elevates when detecting moving targets in strong ground clutter, a time-frequency 2D detection algorithm is presented. The algorithm is researched and analyzed firstly. Then the system hardware based on DSP is designed. Algorithm program is realized by using C language and the ground moving targets detection is accomplished. Pre-processing module, A/D conversion module and DSP signal processing module are designed. The software function and its realization method are discussed. Finally, ground moving targets detection is realized via this hardware. The application of the system in army shows that the operation of the system is stable and reliable, and the algorithm could reduce the detection false alarm in ground moving targets detection.

articleTitle: Speech endpoint detection with low SNR based on HHTSM
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Speech endpoint detection is difficult in low SNR environment. The article presents a detection method based on Hilbert-Huang Transform Spectral Matrix (HHTSM) for improving speech endpoint detection accuracy in low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR). The method analyses signal time-frequency-energy distribution with Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT), and constructs HHTSM by frames. The frame size is chosen by energy focus character. The speech and noise energy distribution can be distinguished by HHTSM in low SNR. By estimating noise energy distribution, it sets threshold automatically. The result indicates that the method can detect speech endpoint effectively in the negative SNR. So the method based on HHTSM is effective.

articleTitle: FPGA implementation of trellis coded modulation encode on SDR communication system
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: This paper refers to the standard coding architecture of Trellis-Coded Modulation (TCM) specified in IESS-310 (INTELSAT EARTH STATION STANDARDS), illustrates and analyzes the Phase Ambiguity Resolution Encoder, Convolutional Encoder and Constellation Mapper in TCM coding mechanism, and also explores and produces the integration design of coding and modulation of TCM. Different from the conventional TCM trellis diagram, this paper adopts special designed TCM coding diagram to produce the coding procedure. Finally, it realizes the hardware circuit of proposed TCM coding on the system platform of Software Define Radio (SDR) [1].

articleTitle: Image processing-based technology for dirt detection of quartz wafer
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Quartz wafer inevitably produces various physical defects in the production process. This paper focuses on the quartz wafer dirt defects, and proposes a way for image processing on the quartz wafer by using of computer vision library OpenCV. The proposed method is to find contours of the processed images to judge whether there is dirt or not. Experiments show that this method can well detect the dirt of quartz wafer.

articleTitle: Project about developing autonomous maintenance support system in 4 m × 3 m WT
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: This paper summarizes the developing autonomous maintenance support system in 4m×3m WT, describes in detail the project implementation, the main advanced points, effects and application situation, the use of funds, documents archived situation and so on. The application results through the serial tests show that the developed system has successfully achieved the expected targets and has forecast, efficient, economical merit about the test equipments maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on information analysis method and application of laser-inducing chlorophyll fluorescence image
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Chlorophyll fluorescent information is closely related to the vital movement of a plant, so it can be used as a probe of the natural environment so as to quickly and accurately reflect the state of the environment around plants. A studying method of the plant leaves chlorophyll fluorescence image combining with remote sensing technology is presented in this paper. The system is designed and established to obtain the fluorescence image information of different plants in different states using an Nd:YAG solid-state laser as its excitation light source and an ICCD as the experimental image detector. The image information features are analyzed with pseudo-color enhancement, image synthesis using RGB color model and other methods. The results show that the fluorescence image can effectively reflect the texture, damage as well as the physiological state of a plant leaf, which can provide technical references for the further research on the impact of the change in environmental conditions by the fluorescence characteristics of plants.

articleTitle: Truncated particle filter based on QMC sampling and application to target tracking
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In order to deal with the nonlinear, non-Gaussian problem, this paper proposes the truncated particle filer based on quasi-Monte Carlo (QMC) sampling. This algorithm replaces the resampling scheme with the truncating scheme which preserves the large weight particles and discards the small weight particles by the truncated threshold. Because the Monte Carlo sampling can induces the possible gaps and clusters, the new proposed algorithm utilizes the QMC method to sample particles uniformly. The results show that the algorithm improves the estimate accuracy.

articleTitle: Civil air defence alarm system based on embedded Linux
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: People's civil air defense is an important part of modern national defense. Aiming at elder defense equipment and lower the degree of automation in many place, particular Langfang city is located in the Beijing-Tianjin corridor, it is urgent to improve and perfect the protection measures, realize the alarm and command system automation and equipment modernization. In this paper, starting from the system requirements analysis, the composition and function of civil air defense alarm control system is discussed, the overall scheme of automatic alarm system based on ARM and embedded Linux system is proposed, and the design and implementation of embedded terminal of civil air defense alarm which is take the S3C2440A chip and the CDMA module as the core is researched. By the siren verification, the system can reliably complete the scheduled functions and requirements.

articleTitle: High resolution object image based on ground based pseudo-random code Cw sar
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Ground based SAR system has many applications in ground structures monitoring. Normally, the radar system is constructed by linear frequency modulation. Pseudo-random code has the properties that its autocorrelation function has sharp peak like noise. In this paper, a new ground based SAR system based on code phase modulation is proposed, and the constructive diagram of ground based pseudo random code SAR system is given. Based on time parallel correlation, the range compression is performed and the azimuth compression is discussed. The simulation results show the efficiency of the algorithm of image forming.

articleTitle: Choice of sampling frequency for Gps signal simulator calibration receiver and influence on spread-spectrum ranging
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: As the GPS signal simulator is applied more and more extensively, the test equipment of the GPS signal simulator is required higher and higher. Currently, the calibration using the standard instrument is the most important means, which severely restricts the test environment of the simulator. In order to meet the test requirements of the GPS signal simulator for diversified situation, this paper proposes a design of the calibration receiver using the direct RF sampling technology and gives the design scheme. Based on the bandpass sampling theorem, the determination method of the sampling frequency for multiband signal is analyzed and the sampling frequency of the calibration receiver is determined. In addition, the range accuacy is the critical factor influencing on the test performance of the calibration receiver, and the sampling noise becomes the main error source for the calibration receiver using the direct RF sampling technology, so the range error caused by the sampling noise is analyzed in detail. The results show that the range error caused by the sampling noise tends to be constant when the CNR is over 85dB-Hz. For L1 P code, L2 P code and L5 P code, the range error generated by the calibration receiver doesn't exceed 5.2 mm, 4.3mm and 4.1mm, respectively, when the CNR of the test signal generated by the GPS simulator is set to 85dB-Hz.

articleTitle: Design of distributed photoelectric measurement system based on SNMP
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Network management system based on SNMP is a new way to manage the distributed photoelectric theodolites and their components. This paper presents the design of SNMP network management system by VC++ in Windows XP professional. Basic knowledge on network management and SNMP, SNMP architecture in Windows XP professional and program construction of network management system for theodolites and their components are also presented.

articleTitle: Prediction for ATE state parameters based on improved LS-SVM
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: An improved least squares support vector machines (LS-SVM) was proposed to improve the sparse and robust performance of LS-SVM in the small samples prediction. The sparse and robust performance could be improved through adding elements of weighted LS-SVM and robust LS-SVM. We introduced a contrast experiment for ATE parameters prediction control through the three methods of neural network, LS-SVM and improved LS-SVM algorithm. Simulation results show that the improved LS-SVM algorithm has good performance in ATE parameters prediction, which succeeds in stability assessment for an aviation ATE.

articleTitle: Comparing reconstruction algorithms for different size of object in electrical tomography
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Electrical tomography is widely used in industrial process and clinical science because of its characteristics of fast response and continuous monitoring. Image reconstruction algorithms are proposed and developed to improve the quality of reconstructed image. In the continuous monitoring, the size of object is always changing, so it is important to compare imaging ability of different algorithms for different size of object. In this paper, circle models and square models of different size object are established. Through the analysis of image error and correlation coefficient, ten image reconstruction algorithms are evaluated detailed.

articleTitle: LDPC coded MSK-BOC modulation for satellite navigation system
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Signal structure is one of the decisive factors of the inherent performance of satellite navigation system, meanwhile it is one of the critical technologies which must be resolved during system design and upgrading process. In order to improve code tracking precision and have the better bit error rate (BER) ability at the same time, we combine low-density party-check (LDPC) codes and minimum shift keying (MSK) with binary offset carrier (BOC), which called LDPC coded MSK-BOC (LDPC-MSK-BOC). Theoretic analysis and simulation results show that the proposed signal system can not only achieve lower BER, but also have better performance in the aspects of Multipath Error, code tracking error and Gabor Bandwidth. Meanwhile, the proposed signal structure can provide potential opportunities for Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) modernization and construction, such as Galileo, Compass, and so on.

articleTitle: New test and analysis of horizontal earth electrodes' TGR on grassplot
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a new type of portable horizontal grid earth electrode has been designed for mobile equipments. With FDTD method and the impulse ground measurement system, different number of earth electrodes' responses to double exponential pulse current have been tested on grassplot. After filtering and calculating, the curve of Transient Grounding Resistance (TGR) in time domain can be gotten. The analysis of discharging capacity of horizontal grid earth electrodes in time domain has great significance in the design of mobile equipments' earth devices.

articleTitle: Novel calibration method for magnetic source in magnetic tracking system
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Magnetic tracking technology using tri-axial magnetic source is widely used in medical positioning and tracking equipment. Calibration of the system prior to the measurement is required in order to achieve better accuracy. In normal circumstances, optical positioning system is used to calibrate the magnetic positioning system. In this paper, a new calibration method of magnetic system is presented by using magnetic field and micro-motion platform. It is possible to solve the sight constraints of the optical system. The simulation result shows that this method has high calibration accuracy.

articleTitle: An approach to generating test data sequences of boundary scan test system
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The research on boundary scan test has Become an important issue because of IEEE 1149.1 standard providing an effective approach to test devices, circuit boards or system with physical limited access. In this paper, the definition of a testing data sequence is proposed, and the aspects which influences on the generating of testing data sequences, such as the boundary scan chain structure, the test configuration script, interconnection net-list, BSCR's structure and support fault types are excavated out. Based on the analyses of BSDL files of JTAG device, the circuits or system net-list files, the approach of generating test data sequences are proposed. The proposed approach supports integrality testing, interconnect testing, device function testing, sample testing, personality testing and so on. A prototype testing platform based on boundary scan test is constructed in order to validate the affectivity of the proposed approach. The experiments show that the proposed approach is effective.

articleTitle: Reactive ion etching optimization method based on orthogonal experiment
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The orthogonal experiment is used for selecting parameters of the etching SIO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> equipment. The process applies etching uniformity and etching rate as evaluation indexes. The main factors influencing etching process are found out. Through further optimization, the advanced SIO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> etching is made to realize etching uniformity less than 5% and etching rate higher than 300nm/min.

articleTitle: Evaluation of GNSS timing performance based on circular T and analysis of system time offset
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The paper first gives an analysis of timing service summary. With the development of multi-mode satellite navigation, it is expected that the evaluation of timing performance and monitoring of system time offset will be the research focus in the future. Through publication of BIPM Circular T the paper evaluates GNSS timing performance, and compared with GPS presents larger timing offset in GLONASS with the errors fluctuation around ± 10ns. Moreover, after modifying the receiver traceability data to UTC we analyze the errors of system time offset: different time precision in each navigation system may lead to greatly relative change in GNSS time offset.

articleTitle: Averaging position algorithm of an independent rotating coils based electromagnetic tracking system
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: When it comes to the navigation tool for minimally invasive surgery, electromagnetic tracking has prominent advantages and features over the traditional endoscope and X-ray imaging. The electromagnetic tracking system using two DC pulsed independent rotating coils to generate two changing magnetic fields alternately can track the position and orientation of the magnetic sensor based on an non-iterative algorithm. However, owing to the restrain of the step size and the distortion of the magnetic field, the coils cannot be pointing at the sensor accurately in the real system. Thus the problem of low resolution area is raised. In this paper, an optimized position algorithm, averaging position algorithm, is proposed to solve the problem of the non-coplanar two coils and the low resolution area. The simulation results demonstrate that the overall static position tracking accuracy was improved by 97.1%, from 11.722 cm to 0.336 cm, when the pointing angle inaccuracy is 0.346°. Further real system research based on the optimized position algorithm should be conducted to offer better navigation performance for the minimally invasive surgery.

articleTitle: Research of balanced network measurement based on Vector Network Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Balanced device is becoming more and more common in communication system. The characteristic of a balanced network is described by mixed-mode S parameters. Traditional two-port Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) is used to measure S parameters which describe single ended network. So how to measure the mixed-mode S parameters is of great challenge to engineers. With the coming up of new four-port VNA and new test method, getting mixed-mode S parameters becomes much easier. In this paper, the balanced network and the definition of mixed-mode S parameters were introduced at first, and two ways of measuring mixed-mode S parameters were presented. Then the method of transmitting single ended S parameters to mixed-mode S parameters was researched. Finally, the true mode stimulation measurement was analyzed. Finally an example was given to demonstrate the measurement process.

articleTitle: Test technology for amplitude-phase coherence of multi-channel phase coherent signal
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Firstly, this paper introduces amplitude-phase characteristic test requirement and application of multi-channel phase coherent signal, and then puts emphasis on realizing accurate test for amplitude-phase coherence of multi-channel phase coherent signal with frequency tracking and vector error correction technology. Finally, the feasibility of this method is proved by experiment data of multi-channel receivers.

Author Keywords: The vector error correction neural classifier

articleTitle: New method for measuring the different region thermal resistance of AlGaAs/GaAs HEMTs in a large temperature range
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The thermal resistance of different region in the AlGaAs/GaAs HEMTs is measured in a large temperature range by the pulsed switching electrical method. The thermal resistance of the chip solders and base can be measured, respectively, through the cooling response curve processed by the structure method. As the temperature increases, the total thermal resistance increases by 50% from −20 °C to 150 °C. And the increase of chip thermal resistance is about 67.2% of the total increased thermal resistance. It can be attributed to the decrease of the chip heat conductivity and the enhancement of phonons collisions. The result is significant for the thermal design and the reliability design of HEMTs.

articleTitle: Design method of low-power photovoltaic grid-connected inverter based on XE162FN
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: This paper proposes a design method of low-power photovoltaic grid-connected inverter. The design method is made up of XE162FN control system, DC-AC converter, DC-AC inverter circuit, signal detection circuit and control circuit. The control algorithm of maximum power point tracking has quickly dynamic response and highly steady state accuracy; the control algorithm of grid-connected can realize inverter operating with the grid steadily and higher quality of current output; the algorithm of island protection is able to detect the island phenomenon and switch on the protection action quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Processing method of marine radar image based on wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments

articleTitle: Simulation optimization of performance for extraordinary magnetoresistance sensor in low-field
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Extraordinary magnetoresistance (EMR) devices hold a large potential and rise quickly recently. We utilize the FEM tools to establish the EMR modelling that is very good agreement with the experimental results. On this basis, the low-field sensitivity in EMR sensors with classical van der Pauw structure became our research emphasis. Through the optimized design to the geometry parameter include filling factor and the position of voltage measurement points, we find that not only the low-filed sensitivity will be drastically enhanced in optimum configuration, but also the linearity of response is improved. It suggests that EMR sensors still hold on to the advantage position, and our research will be helpful to the manufacture of the magnetic field sensors.

articleTitle: New kind of orthogonal grid generation algorithm in FDTD
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Aiming at the grid generation problem in FDTD, a new kind of orthogonal grid generation algorithm based on polar angle judgment is provided. This algorithm cuts the object of characteristic of electromagnetic scattering which needs to be researched into a set of star polygons (polyhedrons) and judges the polar angle range of grid central point of each star polygon (polyhedron). Thus, based on the judgment of the grid central point, the inner grids are remained to generate the orthogonal grids. This algorithm can avoid the problem of singularity in the Kalay orthogonal grid generation algorithm and is better than Kalay's algorithm in computing complexity.

articleTitle: Design of X ray intermediate ballistic velocimeter
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: This paper describes the research on the use of X ray as intermediate ballistic projectile velocity measurement using zone-block device. This is a new measuring system, the velocity of projectile is measured using X ray. The paper introduces the working principle and the construction of the test system, analyses the uncertainty of measurement, complete detection, signal processing, timer and directly display. The design principle of velocity of each circuit is given. The feasibility of the test method is verified by experiment. The cost is far lower than the pulsed X ray photography method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of spectrum synthetic based on virtual instrument
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Using the successful experience of Software Radio for reference, taking the generation and reception of the signal as research object, the general auto test platform is divided into several LXI test modules, which are mutually independent. The LXI digitizer module and the LXI Down-Converter module are selected as the platform of spectrum synthetic. In the design of its spectrum software design, the Labwindows/CVI is taken as the development tool, and the multi-thread technique is applied to ensure the running speed and response speed. Finally, the synthetic of spectrum analysis is achieved, which lay the foundation of the practicality of the Synthetic Instrument.

articleTitle: Accurate delay measurement of BPSK modulator for time transfer
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: BPSK (binary phase shift keying) modulator is widely applied for time signal modulating in time transfer. The delay measurement precision of BPSK modulator is the key factor of the time transfer precision. A high accurate delay measurement of BPSK modulator is developed. Input signal and output signal of BPSK modulator are up-sampled in synchronization. After digital signal processing is done for the sampling data, the delay of BPSK modulator can be obtained. The absolute uncertainty with the proposed algorithm is less than 0.2ns with the sampling frequency 10 G Sa/s.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of satellite payload data loader
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: To meet the test requirements of a remote sensing satellite payload and data transmission system, the satellite payload data loader was designed and implemented based on the PXI & PXIE architecture. The payload data loader was divided into eight functional modules hierarchically with the modular design concept, such as high speed payload data simulators, low speed payload data simulator, payload data framing module and data transmission riser cards. In these modules, FPGA was used as the core controller, the flash array and compact flash card were adopted as the storage devices to achieve a single-board storage capacity of 128GB and peak reading and writing speed of over 100MB/s. The capacitive isolation technology was used to isolate satellite signals and ground signals. The payload data loader was used in the electrical testing of satellite, and played a significant role in the hierarchical test of satellite payload and data transmission system.

articleTitle: Research on harmonic current detection method background of microgrid
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Due to the type of power in the microgrid are numerous, intermittent and randomness, and is accompanied by a large number of inverters, so the power quality problems such as harmonics are produced. For this reson, this paper presents a new power quality detection method, this method used the Chain Mixed Morphological Filter (CMMF) instead of the Low-Pass Filter (LPF) in the conventional i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub> - i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub> detection method based on the instantaneous reactive power theory, it maked many Mixed Morphological Filters gettd serially concatenated, and rational choosed the shape and length of the structural elements of each Mixed Morphological Filter, to achieve the best detection. Simulation results show that, this method can be fast and accurate detection of harmonic signals.

articleTitle: Transfer function calibration of LEMP electric field intrument based on bounded wave simulator
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Lightning fields are commonly obtained by integrating the output of antennas that produce replicas of the derivatives of the wanted quantities. The integration is carried out using RC integral circuits that introduce a distortion in the form of a decay time constant that may affect the response of the LEMP electric field sensor. As the decay time constant demonstrate different feature of the electric field instrument, we present a method for transfer function calibration of LEMP electric field instrument. Combine with the 1.2/50μs excitation pulse source and bounded wave simulator, experimental validation is carried by using the transfer function for compensating the response of the LEMP electric field sensor. Finally, this method is applied to observational data of an IC flash.

articleTitle: Cache performance analysis based on the EDMA transfer chain
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: This paper discusses the use of EDMA in real time image processing systems, high-resolution panoramic vision unfolding system based on TMS320DM642, which continuously update dynamic image data in ping-pong cache. And analyze the cache performance. The cache strategy is based on the channel chaining capability of the EDMA channel controller. Each EDMA transfer synchronized with another transfer. Then the CPU would continuously process the cached data and do not pay attention to any synchronization of each EDMA channel. This cache strategy can obtain the highest performance in DSP system.

articleTitle: Research of small parts gesture estimation based on multilevel RVM regression
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: As to the real-time positioning demands for micro assembly process, this paper proposes a way which is based on Relevance Vector Machine Regression (RVMR). It solves the low efficiency problem which usually accompanies other common regression algorithms because the regression pattern is not sparse enough. This paper brings out grading RVMR, adopting the thought what is called “From coarse to fine”. In this way, the number of training samples is greatly reduced while guaranteeing precision. So the off-line training efficiency is improved, meeting various parts in micro assembly process. In this algorithm, the algebra feature of the part image is extracted as the RVM's input, using Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Experiments on many regression algorithms and grading RVMR are both carried on. The results show that RVMR gets the shortest measuring time and the highest accuracy. The single axis estimation precision of part attitude is better than 0.5°.

articleTitle: Influence of multiple scattering on the measurement of light attenuation by water filled with bubbles
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Using a solution of the radiation transfer equation in the small angle approximation, we examine the effect of multiple scattering on the measurement of the light beam attenuation in an aquatic environment abundant in bubbles created by movement of ship or sea animals. According to the measurement condition, the correction coefficient denoting the extent of multiple scattering is introduced, which is a function of detector field of view (FOV), beam transfer distance, beam size and energy-received section size. Given a typical bubble clouds' distribution function, numerical computations and the analysis between the correction coefficient and its four parameters are provided. The results show that the multiple scattering is obvious when measuring the light attenuation by water filled with large numbers of bubbles, and the degree of multiple scattering changes along with measurement parameters.

articleTitle: Study on the towerless calibration method for pulse instrumentation radar based on offset dipole compensation
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Directional sensitivity and amplitude-phase consistent are the key factor that can affect the stability and precision of tracking targets for pulse instrumentation radar, so they need to be calibrated. For the shortcomings of traditional tower calibration, the towerless calibration method based on offset dipole compensation is proposed. And the feasibility is checked according to analysis of offset dipole compensation. The towerless calibrating system is designed and put into use in tracking a certain satellite. The tracking experiment indicates that the calibration result using towerless is superior to tower, and the system satisfies the demand of pulse instrumentation radar.

articleTitle: Approach for image segmentation based on improved visual attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The computational model of visual attention mechanism could be used to solve the deficiency of classical image segmentation algorithm such as setting parameter. In view of the Itti model has the problems that edge blur, low efficiency and the saliency map is not obvious, an improved visual attention mechanism is proposed in this paper. It introduces the edge enhancement equation, uses the combination strategy based on weight, and so on. The improved visual attention mechanism combines with the level set method. The binarization saliency map is evolved to obtain the image segmentation result. The experiments show that the proposed algorithm outperforms the SVM algorithm, the adaptive threshold algorithm and the Kmeans clustering algorithm in image segmentation, and it shows strong robustness.

articleTitle: Error analysis and calibration of two-way microwave time transfer equipment
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments

articleTitle: Optimal design of adjustable frequency response linear-phase filters
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: A digital linear-phase finite-length impulse response (FIR) filter design method is proposed, which has adjustable frequency response. For this purpose, Farrow structure is employed in which the overall transfer function is a weighted linear combination of fixed subfilters and where the weights are directly determined by the input parameter. Optimal design technique is introduced which generates globally optimal overall filters in the Chebyshev sense over a whole set of filter specifications. An example is included in the paper to demonstrate the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Simulation and experimental study on coaxial pulse probe
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: A coaxial pulse probe is designed and tested. The probe with different monopole is simulated and compared, and the experiment on the coaxial pulse probe with spiry monopole is carried out. The simulation and the experimental results indicate that the probe with spiry monopole could be used in the measurement of electromagnetic pulse (EMP) with rising time of nanosecond. Finally, to integrate the differential coupling output signal of the coaxial pulse probe, a novel coaxial passive integrator is proposed and simulated.

articleTitle: Optimal vector method for image reconstruction of the uniplanar multi-electrode system
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments

articleTitle: Review: The influence of the acceleration effect of crystal oscillator for electronic equipments
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: As an essential unit of electronic equipments, crystal oscillator is widely used as frequency controller because of its high Q value and low consumption. However, crystal oscillator is sensitive to acceleration. In this paper, the effect and expression for vibration of crystal oscillator are analyzed, and the applications of crystal oscillator in electronic equipments are reviewed in detail. And then the influence of oscillator's acceleration effect for wideband communication and radio detection equipments are studied.

articleTitle: Metrological study on test methods for corneal topographer
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Corneal topographer is now widely used in clinical and scientific work to assess the shape of the cornea, and it is important to know how well they perform. The studies have been carried out to test their accuracy and precision by using calibrated test surfaces internationally, while there are only few practical studies in China. In this paper, three test surfaces that resemble typical corneal shapes, including spherical, ellipsoidal and toroidal surfaces, are manufactured. The accuracy of the test surface is established by Ultrahigh Accurate 3-D Profilemeter. The experimental studies are carried out on three types of corneal topographer, and the results show that the test surfaces have good practical application. However, further study shall be gone on to find a commonly acceptable routine testing method for corneal topographer.

articleTitle: Research on friction torque test system of gyro motor bearing
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Gyro motor is a very sophisticated machine with high precision and high rotation speed up to 60000r/min, and its structure isn't allowed any external interferences. Friction torque measurement of gyro motor is very complex and demands high measuring precision about 0.2gcm. Aiming at that the nut pretightening force can't be measured and it is difficult to quantitatively evaluate the manual testing for dynamic friction torque of high-speed gyro motor, the principle of dynamic friction torque measurement of gyro motor and an automatic testing method are proposed based on analyzing the restoring torque of friction torque when gyro motor is rotating at a high speed, simultaneously. The instruments and the control system, which are used to test the screw nut pretightening force, dynamic friction torque and inertia time are designed. The experimental results demonstrate that the measurement system is accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of massive test metrical information management system in static structural test of aircraft
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE 11th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: A massive test metrical information management system was designed and implemented, against the characteristic of massive test metrical information and the present status of lack of governing. The development platform for the system is Delphi 7.0, which is combined with Microsoft SQL Server 2000 database, and the Client/Server (c/s) structure was applied. In order to implement all functions of the system, firstly, function requirements analysis and division of functional module were performed; and then database modeling was executed; finally, the database structure and their applications were designed. The application of the system in practice proves that management system is an effective, accurate and convenient tool for mass test information management and processing, with which the productivity effect can be significantly improved.
